Name: Lemonade Stand Machine Compatible with More Fruit Trees (PFM)
Author: krissymarie
Description:
[b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=3]"Lemonade Stand" Machine for Producer Framework Mod (PFM)[/size][/font]
[/b]
[font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]Lemonade Stand Machine was designed for use with vanilla fruit trees, [PFM] More Fruit Trees, and [JA] Bonster's Trees, and inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3229]TNT's Lemonade Machine[/url]﻿.  More Fruit Trees/Bonster's Trees is not required, but all its crops categorized as "fruit" will produce a lemonade ([i]even fig, mmm[/i]).

Machine Specs
[/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]Sell Price: Base fruit price X 2*[/size][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]Processing time: 12 hours*[/size][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]Crafting Recipe: 30 wood, 20 Stone, 1 Earth Crystal[/size][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]Can produce 41 various flavours of lemonade despite how exotic the resulting combination turns out (Avacado flavoured lemonade, anyone?.[/size][/font]
[/list]
[font=Lucida Sans Unicode]*As of 1.3.1, price is x2 the base price and lemonade keeps the quality of the input (as well as added value)
﻿
Changes:
[size=2]1.3.1 Processes time extended to 12 hours and sell price now x2 base price, improved newest lemonade machine colour option
1.3.0 Retextured lemonade machine without wooden base. Follow instructions on how to change the base back to wooden and select your shade.

Recolour options to match your style of craftables recolouring:
[/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]Vanilla (A)[/size][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]White (B)[/size][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]Midtone Brown (C)[/size][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]Sienna (D)[/size][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]Grey (E)[/size][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]No wood base (Universal)[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]
Selecting a Colour Option (optional)
1.[b] [/b]Inside the folder [b]"Mods\Lemonade Stand Machine\[JA] Lemonade Machine\" [/b]select which option you would like to use and rename it to [b]"big-craftable.png" [/b]
2. Move the file into [b]"Mods\Lemonade Stand Machine\[JA] Lemonade Machine\BigCraftables\" [/b] (overwrite the existing file, which is the default colour if you do not select a different option)

[/size][/font][size=2][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Installation
1. Download and extract any requirements into [b]Stardew Valley/Mods  [/b](More Fruit Trees & Bonster's Trees  is optional, PFM is required)
2. Download and extract [b]Lemonade Stand Machine/ [/b]into [b]Stardew Valley/Mods
[/b][/font][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]
If you have installed the machine properly it will be visible in your crafting menu.
[/font][/size][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]
